question: Should this protected Gateway lifecycle refactor merge after maintainers review the transaction transitions and receive a real reload/restart proof trace?
rationale: The patch intentionally reorganizes state that governs retry and restart availability, so its correctness depends on behavioral equivalence rather than type and unit-test evidence alone.

options.title: Require runtime proof and owner review
options.body: Request a redacted real Gateway reload trace that exercises deferral or retry, then review the transaction transitions before merge.

options.title: Accept focused-test evidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused tests and CI only, accepting the remaining risk that a lifecycle transition differs in a live reload.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof and owner review
recommendation.body: Request a redacted real Gateway reload trace that exercises deferral or retry, then review the transaction transitions before merge.
